name: Cross Tantei Monogatari ~Motsureta Nanatsu no Labyrinth~
original_name: クロス探偵物語～もつれた7つのラビリンス～
source:
The player takes the role of a young 18 years old detective (Koruso Ken) aided by his partner, a young girl of 19 years old (Nishiyama Tomoko) that got a detective agency. The game features 7 different cases that takes place in different places of the city and outside the city, with different characters and suspects in each episode.

[From [url=https://psxdatacenter.com/games/J/C/SLPM-86280.html]psxdatacenter[/url]]
translation:
玩家扮演一名18岁的年轻侦探（Koruso Ken），他的搭档是一位拥有侦探事务所的19岁女孩（西山智子）。游戏有7个不同的案件，发生在城内和城外的不同地方，每集都有不同的人物和嫌疑人。

[来自[url=https://psxdatacenter.com/games/J/C/SLPM-86280.html]psxdatacenter[/url]]
